description: The line plot, titled "Training Loss of 20M Data Size," illustrates the training loss over steps for six different models—ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBARTa Small 20M, ChemBARTa Medium 20M, ChemLLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M—trained on a dataset of 20 million samples. The x-axis, labeled "Step," represents the number of training steps and ranges from 0K to 440K, with major tick marks at 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, 420K, and 440K. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," measures the training loss and ranges from 0.0 to 0.85, with major gridlines at 0.2, 0.4, and 0.75. All six lines exhibit a sharp initial decrease in training loss from approximately 0.75 at step 0K to below 0.2 by step 20K. After this initial drop, the loss for all models continues to decrease gradually and then stabilizes, with the lines clustering closely together between 0.1 and 0.2 for the remainder of the training. The ChemBARTa Small 20M (green) and ChemBARTa Medium 20M (orange) models show slightly higher loss values than the others in the later stages, while the ChemLLaMA models (purple and brown) and ChemBART models (red and blue) show very similar, low loss values. The plot includes a vertical line at approximately 420K, which appears to be a visual separator or marker, and the data for the final steps from 420K to 440K is shown in a zoomed-in inset on the right.
